title: Sum of biased output pivotal probabilities
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, choose an output sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$, and let $p\in(0,1)$. Give the coordinates of $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ independent signs with probability $p$ of being $-1$. For each coordinate $i$, the probability that $f(x)=b$ and flipping coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$ is summed over all $i$; this sum equals the expected number of coordinates with those two properties.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the sign set
the sum ranges over all coordinates in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$
